content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers (2-0) can close out a season-opening sweep of the Arizona Diamondbacks (0-2) when they meet at Dodger Stadium on Saturday night in the series finale.LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA - MARCH 27: Kyle Tucker #23 of the Los Angeles Dodgers hits an RBI single against the Arizona Diamondbacks during the eighth i...How to Watch Diamondbacks vs DodgersDate: Saturday, March 28, 2026Time: 9:00 PM ETChannel: MLB.TV - Arizona DiamondbacksStream: Fubo (TRY FOR FREE)Newcomer Kyle Tucker delivered a go-ahead single in the eighth inning as Los Angeles celebrated receiving its World Series rings with a 5-4 victory on Friday night. The Dodgers took a 4-2 lead with a four-run third inning as Mookie Betts clubbed a three-run homer after Alex Freeland went deep earlier in the frame. The bullpen worked 5.2 scoreless innings after starter Emmet Sheehan struggled, allowing four runs and striking out six in 3.1 innings. Former New York Mets closer Edwin Diaz worked around a walk in the ninth to get his first save as a Dodger.Ketel Marte gave the Diamondbacks a 2-1 lead with a solo homer in the third and Alek Thomas tied the game in the fourth with a two-run double after driving in Arizona’s first run with a double in the second. Starter Ryne Nelson gave up four runs on two hits over 4.2 innings, walking three and striking out four, and reliever Kevin Ginkel surrendered the go-ahead run in the eighth.Right-hander Tyler Glasnow, limited to 18 starts last season, takes the ball for the Dodgers on Saturday night. He worked to a 3.19 ERA and 1.906 WHIP in 90.1 innings with 106 strikeouts.
